description: This Java class, HonoSenderSampler, extends HonoSampler and implements ThreadListener for JMeter testing. It manages sending messages through the Hono messaging client, including configuration for timeouts, message counts, device IDs, and whether to wait for delivery results. It also handles thread start and finish events to initialize and shut down the sender appropriately.
